description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAttachmentDecorator' serves as a decorator for the EmployeeAttachment entity, providing methods to access formatted attachment date, time, attachment content, and setting related employee data. It enhances the entity with presentation and utility logic, following the decorator pattern within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that enhances the EmployeeAttachment entity with additional methods for formatted date/time and content retrieval, facilitating presentation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeAttachment entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Protected getter for the wrapped EmployeeAttachment entity.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attachment's date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the attachment's time formatted as a string.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the attachment based on employee number.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment content as a string, reading from the binary stream only once.
